name: Shouji Chinko Man no Kisetsu
original_name: 障子ちんこマンの季節
source:
An eroge parody of "Taiyou no Kisetsu" (Season of the Sun), an erotic Japanese novel written by politician Ishihara Shintarou, an outspoken opponent of pornography.

[summarized from [url=http://www.sankakucomplex.com/2011/07/08/ishihara-rape-eroge-released/]Sankaku Complex[/url]]
translation:
一部恶搞《太阳的季节》的成人游戏。《太阳的季节》是日本政治家石原慎太郎创作的情色小说，而他本人也是直言不讳的色情作品反对者。

[根据 [url=http://www.sankakucomplex.com/2011/07/08/ishihara-rape-eroge-released/]Sankaku Complex[/url]概述]
